exposure: Persistent middle cerebral artery reversed end diastolic flow (MCA-REDF)
outcome: Bilateral ischaemic changes in the basal ganglia
cohort: A well-grown fetus at 32 weeks' gestation presenting with persistent middle cerebral artery reversed end diastolic flow due to acute, severe anaemia from a large feto-maternal hemorrhage.
finding: Persistent middle cerebral artery reversed end diastolic flow in any fetus is an ominous finding warranting urgent diagnostic evaluation and/or delivery.
mod_finding: An emergency cesarean section was performed in this case due to the ominous fetal findings.
